metadata.description: Microsoft Sentinel Log Analytics workspace name

properties.description:
Detects installation of AI agent skills using the 'clawhub install' command.
The rule compares installed skills against the Approved_AI_Agent_Skills
watchlist for tuning purposes. The rule will not fail if the watchlist
does not exist.
properties.query:
let ApprovedSkills = union isfuzzy=true
    (_GetWatchlist('Approved_AI_Agent_Skills') | project SkillName),
    (datatable(SkillName:string)[])
| distinct SkillName;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(1h)
| where ProcessCommandLine has "clawhub install"
| extend SkillName = extract(@"\bclawhub\s+install\s+([^\s]+)", 1, ProcessCommandLine)
| where isnotempty(SkillName)
| where SkillName !in (ApprovedSkills)
| summarize FirstSeen=min(Timestamp), LastSeen=max(Timestamp), EventCount=count()
    by DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName, SkillName
